review_scope: Separate record and statistical reconstruction plus final prose review; reviewer also authored production statistics/report. Not independent investigators, GPU rerun, model-weight tensor decoding or a new experiment.

decision.label: Useful matched-LR advantage for K_HALF
decision.next_action: Keep K_HALF as the provisional coding base; recommend a separately agreed bounded portability or online-setting check of this fixed base.
decision.scope: Development/ablation evidence conditional on this reused panel and two fixed fitted seeds; equal LR does not match displacement or isolate selection from normalization.

clear_conclusion: K_HALF meets the predeclared useful matched-LR advantage rule on this reused coding panel. Ordinary O_HALF improves over O, but does not remove the incremental K_HALF advantage.
forbidden_overclaim: The lower primary interval bound 0.4548% is below 0.5%; neither a true benefit above 0.5% nor fresh confirmation is established.

cost_summary.scope: Current training times only. Nested timers overlap, process peaks are not total residency, and historicalO/K/K_HALF training times are unmatched context. No comparative serving latency or training-inclusive speedup.

items.name: Simpson's paradox
items.evidence_and_limit: Primary pooled +1.1034%; seeds +1.0703% and +1.1365%. The report also shows K/F's mixed seed signs (+0.1227%, -0.1595%) rather than hiding them behind its -0.0184% pooled value.

items.name: Ecological fallacy
items.evidence_and_limit: Bootstrap uses 128 joint request identities carrying both fitted seeds/all methods;256 seed/request outcomes are descriptive, not 256 independent draws. No population training-seed inference.

items.name: Berkson's selection bias
items.evidence_and_limit: The reserved short-prompt CodeAlpaca panel is conditional data and is reused after favoring K_HALF. This is a generalizability limitation, not evidence that a particular Berkson artifact occurred. No general-domain claim is made.

items.name: Collider bias
items.evidence_and_limit: All 1,072 planned executions are valid and retained; all 128 panel identities remain. No generated-length/performance filtering or complete-case rescue. Existing panel/eligibility, canonical and checkpoint identities are unchanged.

items.name: Base-rate neglect
items.evidence_and_limit: Primary 125 wins/82 regressions/49 ties over 256 seed/request outcomes; gross 336 calls saved/159 added. All methods output 88,266 tokens across those rows;128 distinct canonical requests all terminate by EOS, zero cap hits. Gain retention uses 418 comparator gross-gain calls, not request count.

items.name: Regression to the mean
items.evidence_and_limit: The report explicitly calls this reused-panel development/ablation evidence, not fresh confirmation. Ordinary O_HALF is a meaningful matched-LR control, but the nominal interval does not adjust prior selection of K_HALF.

items.name: Survivorship bias
items.evidence_and_limit: Eight training jobs and 1,072 new evaluations completed with zero invalid/unknown/unattempted scientific work. The earlier source-admission failure occurred before model work and remains separate; no unfavorable request was replaced.

items.name: Look-elsewhere effect
items.evidence_and_limit: All 8 prespecified comparisons, reverse primary, common-F interaction and both seeds are present. Secondary intervals remain descriptive/unadjusted; no new tests or selective significant subset were introduced.

items.name: Garden of forking paths
items.evidence_and_limit: Prespecified endpoint 4, seeds 17/29, LR1.5e-4, panel,10,000 PCG64seed 20261102 joint draws, linear percentiles and A/B/C/D/E rules reproduce. Operational tuple/list/source-deployment repairs are disclosed, with no outcome-driven scientific tuning or extra steps.

items.name: Correlation versus causation
items.evidence_and_limit: The comparison supports the implemented K recipe at matched LR, including selection and normalization together. It does not identify gradient conflict, memorization, preservation, optimal LR or a closed-loop deployment mechanism. Gain/harm is accounting, not proof of causation.

items.name: Reverse causality
items.assessment: No leakage/temporal reversal detected in reviewed records
items.evidence_and_limit: The immutable evaluation panel and original O-generated feedback/schedules were sealed independently of these endpoint outcomes. Evaluation stays outside training; future performance is not used to select the observed learning trajectory.

fallacy_scan.caution: Reused selected development panel, two fitted seeds, conditional nominal intervals and unadjusted secondary comparisons.

one_recommendation: Keep K_HALF as the provisional coding base and seek agreement on one bounded portability or online-setting check of that fixed base.
